attributes.board_name: Vermont Secretary of State, Office of Professional Regulation (OPR)

rules.alternatives: Instead of the 20 hours, proof of an active ASHA CCC-SLP designation is accepted at renewal.
rules.audit_note: Attest and upload course completion certificates in the online renewal. 30 days after the renewal period ends OPR audits a random percentage of licensees; a failed audit must be cured within 90 days.
rules.notes: OPR renewal instructions (February 2026): proof of 20 hours of continuing education OR proof of active ASHA CCC-SLP. All OPR licenses renew on a fixed biennial cycle set for the profession; the expiration date is printed on the license. The statute leaves CE details to the Director; the SLP administrative rules were not available online to cite a rule section.

rules.alternatives: No CE step in the OPR audiology renewal instructions (February 2026). The statute allows the Director to require CE by rule, but no audiologist CE rule is in force.
rules.notes: Licenses renew every two years (26 V.S.A. § 3296(a)). The only posted rules (Administrative Rules for Hearing Aid Dispensers, 1991) contain no CE requirement. Check the renewal instructions before each renewal in case OPR adopts a CE rule.
